sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: Today, we release LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest and final model in the LFM2.5 family, which now spans two orders of magnitude: from LFM2.5-230M to LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: Unlike LFM2-24B-A2B, LFM2.5-24B-A2B always thinks before it answers. The chat template opens every assistant turn with a <think> tag, so responses contain an explicit chain of thought before the final answer.

sources.title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It thinks before it answers, calls tools, and works through multi-step tasks inside popular agent harnesses. Because only 2B parameters are active per token, each reasoning token is cheap, so you can run agents continuously on your own hardware.
